quotes.speaker: Nikola Jović
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jović on the Miami Heat's current roster depth
quotes.excerpt: I have eight players on the roster. Nobody is a standard player, so it will be strange.
quotes.quote: I am looking at the current roster, and we have eight players. Bam Adebayo, Giannis Antetokounmpo, myself, and Bobby Portis. Nobody is a standard player, so it will be strange, but from the side, I understand Miami. Erik Spoelstra really chases that top-notch defense. With any team, he will be in the top 10 defenses. I saw some statistics, and he is number one. Now he has Bam, who can protect everything, and Giannis, who can protect everything, so I think he will achieve what he wanted.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: I ja mislim sad gledam trenutno roster, mi imamo osam igrača. Bam, Janis, ja i Bobi Portis. Niko nije realno standardna petica. Čista petica. Tako da biće čudno sigurno, ali sa strane Majamija ja razumem to. Erik Spolstra stvarno juri tu vrhunsku odbranu. On sa bilo kojom ekipom će biti u top 10 odbrana. Ja sam video neku statistiku i on je broj jedan. Sad ima Bama koji može sve da čuva i Janisa koji može sve da čuva, tako da mislim da će on postići to što je hteo.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jović
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jović on trade rumors and his relationship with the Heat
quotes.excerpt: I was in the story for a trade for Kevin Durant twice, for Kyrie Irving, for Lillard.
quotes.quote: Since I came to Miami, I was in the story for a trade for Kevin Durant twice, for Kyrie Irving, for Lillard, it was done already. Lillard publicly announced he is coming to Miami. That was like, I want Miami and that is it. For Lillard, I was in for Jovic and Tyler Herro. Tyler Herro, brother, what he survived, that nowhere exists. In the end, he did not survive. But I mean, I am in every trade, I am in every trade, and I am in every trade. I am really in every trade, so it is not easy, I mean, you play in a club and now you read every summer that you are not good enough, you need someone new, some bigger star. It is certainly not easy for him.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Ja od kad sam došao u Majami, bio sam u priči za trejd za Kevina Durenta dva puta, za Kajri Irvinga, za Lilarda je bilo gotovo već. Lilard je javno izjavio da dolazi u Majami. To je bilo kao ja hoću Majami i to je to. Za Lilarda sam bio ja u priči i Tajler Hiro. Tajler Hiro brate šta je on preživeo, to nigde ne postoji. Na kraju nije preživeo. Ali mislim ja sam u svakom trejdu, ja sam u svakom trejdu, i ja sam u svakom trejdu. Ja sam stvarno u svakom trejdu, tako da nije lako, mislim igraš u klubu i sad čitaš svakog leta da nisi dovoljno dobar, treba neko novi, neka veća zvezda. Sigurno nije lako njemu.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Jović
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jović on his development and learning from Heat veterans
quotes.excerpt: I learned a lot from all of them because the level they are at, Kyle Lowry, Jimmy Butler, Bam Adebayo, Kevin Love.
quotes.quote: I learned a lot from all of them because the level they are at, Kyle Lowry, Jimmy Butler, Bam Adebayo, Kevin Love, and all those players, they are at a level that everyone would like to be at. And a lot can be learned from them. But I say, the most I certainly learned from those details, how to train, how to recover, how some live outside of basketball, and so on. For example, Jimmy always told me that I must find something that will fulfill me outside of basketball. Something that will motivate me outside of basketball. And so there are a lot of those little things, now I do not have exactly one that I could highlight, but I emphasize.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Ja sam mnogo naučio od svih njih jer nivo na kom su oni, Kajl Lauri, Džimi Batler, Bam Adebajo, Kevin Lav, i svi ti igrači, oni su na nivou na kom bi svako voleo da bude. I mnogo se može naučiti od njih. Ali kažem, najviše sam sigurno naučio o tim detaljima, kako se trenira, kako se oporavlja, kako neki žive van košarke, i tako dalje. Na primer, Džimi mi je uvek govorio da moram da nađem nešto što će me ispunjavati van košarke. Nešto što će me motivisati van košarke. I tako ima mnogo tih sitnica, sad nemam baš jednu koju bih mogao da izdvojim, ali naglašavam.
